request_body.raw_goal: Learn to paint with watercolors. I've always wanted to try.
request_body.user_context: Recently retired schoolteacher, Portland. Widowed two years ago. No deadlines, no career pressure. Wants structure and purpose, not achievement targets. Low weekly hours — this is how she likes it.

objectives: Develop foundational knowledge of watercolor materials, including paper types, pigment properties, and brush mechanics.
Master essential techniques for managing water-to-paint ratios and controlling pigment flow on the paper surface.
Execute basic color mixing and application methods to establish control over tone, saturation, and transparency.
Establish a consistent, low-pressure creative habit for exploring watercolor painting in a personal studio or home environment.

proposed_milestones.description: Establish a basic watercolor kit and understand the interaction between paper, pigment, and water.
objectives: Select and source beginner-friendly materials including cold-press watercolor paper, a limited primary palette, and round brushes.
Practice 'wet-on-dry' and 'wet-on-wet' techniques on test swatches to observe how water affects pigment dispersion.
Learn standard studio hygiene for brush care and palette maintenance to ensure longevity of supplies.

proposed_milestones.description: Execute core water-control exercises to develop muscle memory for paint application.
objectives: Complete flat washes and graded wash exercises to achieve smooth, even pigment distribution across the paper.
Practice controlling paint edges and preventing unwanted 'blooms' or backruns while the paint is drying.
Create a personal color chart to observe how different pigments behave when thinned with varying amounts of water.

proposed_milestones.description: Explore color theory and layering through simple, low-stakes painting studies.
objectives: Practice color mixing on the palette to create secondary and tertiary hues, focusing on color harmony.
Experiment with 'glazing'—applying transparent layers of color over dried layers to build depth.
Paint simple subjects from observation or reference, focusing on shape and color rather than technical precision.

success_metrics: Completion of a full color chart demonstrating various water-to-pigment ratios for all initial tubes of paint.
Ability to execute a smooth, consistent 4x4 inch flat wash without visible streaks or pooling.
Successful completion of three small-scale landscape or floral studies using at least two glazing layers each.
Established routine of painting at least once a week without reliance on formal instruction or tutorials.

request_body.raw_goal: Volunteer at my local library once a week. I miss being around people and books.
request_body.user_context: Emotionally significant — rebuilding social rhythm after widowhood. Structurally simple. No deadline. Still has watercolor goal active.

objectives: Identify a local library with an active volunteer program.
Navigate the onboarding and background check process required for library volunteers.
Integrate a recurring weekly shift into a personal schedule to facilitate social connection.
Establish a rapport with library staff and patrons to foster a sense of community engagement.

proposed_milestones.description: Conduct administrative outreach to local municipal or county library systems.
objectives: Search library websites for 'Volunteer Opportunities' or 'Friends of the Library' pages.
Submit volunteer inquiry forms or contact the volunteer coordinator via email or phone.
Confirm the availability of roles that align with interest in public-facing library work.

proposed_milestones.description: Complete the institutional onboarding and security clearance requirements.
objectives: Attend the volunteer orientation session provided by library administration.
Submit necessary identification for mandatory background or reference checks.
Review library code of conduct and patron privacy policies.

proposed_milestones.description: Commence and stabilize the weekly volunteer shift.
objectives: Confirm a recurring weekly time slot with the branch manager.
Complete the first three consecutive weekly shifts to establish a social rhythm.
Learn the organizational system for book shelving, circulation desk support, or program assistance.

success_metrics: Successfully onboarded as a volunteer at a chosen library branch.
Maintained a consistent weekly attendance record for a period of one month.
Completed at least one full cycle of the library's required operational tasks during a shift.
